HOME_SUBTITLE: Login with password, Google, or Facebook using the same user model as the mobile app.
REGISTER_SUBTITLE: Create an account if you do not use Google or Facebook login.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Invalid credentials or user not registered.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_HINT: Enter your account email. We will send a link to reset your password.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_SUCCESS: If the email is registered, you will receive a password reset link.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_ERROR: Could not send the recovery email. Please try again.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE: Password recovery is not available in demo mode.
REGISTER_PHONE_HELP: Enter mobile number with area code (10 or 11 digits).
REGISTER_ERROR_PHONE_REQUIRED: Enter a valid mobile number with area code.
REGISTER_ERROR_GENERIC: Could not create account. Please try again.
PATIENT_AREA_SUBTITLE: Chat with the AI agent in text or audio and receive guided feedback.
PSYCHOLOGIST_AREA_SUBTITLE: Track patient interactions, annotate sessions, and tune AI context for daily patient guidance.
PSYCHOLOGIST_DASHBOARD_SUBTITLE: Clinical overview with interaction metrics and care plan adherence.
PSYCHOLOGIST_SESSION_SUBTITLE: Record session notes, consult the AI, and tune clinical context during the appointment.
TOOLTIP_CHART_MOOD_TREND: Monthly average mood extracted by the AI agent from the mood diary and patient messages over the last 6 months.
TOOLTIP_CHART_MOOD_DIARY_ADHERENCE: Data calculated by the AI agent from expected vs. completed mood diary entries.
TOOLTIP_CHART_CLINICAL_THEMES: Data extracted by the AI agent from the frequency of themes in the patient's recent interactions.
PROFILE_INCOMPLETE_ALERT: Some profile data was not provided by the auth provider. Please complete:
PROFILE_LANGUAGE_HELP: Sets the language for Mind Bridge on this device.
NOTIFICATION_BODY: How are you feeling today? Share a quick update with your AI care assistant.
DEFAULT_PATIENT_AI_CONTEXT: Support daily reflection and emotional awareness with empathetic language.
DEFAULT_PSYCHOLOGIST_AI_CONTEXT: Encourage healthy routines, active listening, and reflective questioning.
AI_ERROR_NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Sign in to chat with the agent.
AI_ERROR_PATIENT_REQUIRED: Select a patient to use the copilot.
AI_ERROR_GENERIC: Could not get a response from the agent. Please try again.
AI_AGENT_UNSAFE_RESPONSE: I cannot respond to harmful or discriminatory content. If this is an urgent safety concern, please seek immediate professional help.
AI_AGENT_DEFAULT_RESPONSE: Thank you for sharing this. Can you tell me more about how you felt before and after this situation?
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_CHAT: Chat with the AI agent by text or audio. Responses use your care plan and recent history.
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_CHAT_AUDIO: Use the microphone to dictate your message. Text will appear in the field before you send.
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_SUMMARY: Automatic summary of your AI interactions, including recurring themes and self-care suggestions.
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_NOTIFICATIONS: Enable browser reminders to stay engaged with your care plan between sessions.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_CONTEXT: Set the clinical context the AI should prioritize when analyzing interactions and generating patient insights.
TOOLTIP_SESSION_NOTES_AGENTIC_SUMMARY: Automatic synthesis of psychotherapy session notes from prior sessions to support today's clinical focus.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_SESSION_NOTES: Psychotherapy session notes: agenda, techniques used, and items to review at the next appointment.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_CHAT: Ask the AI to consolidate patient data, detect patterns, and suggest clinical guidance.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_SUMMARY: Aggregated view of the patient's AI interactions, including metrics, risk, and plan adherence.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_INSIGHTS: Automatically suggested indicators, patterns, alerts, and actions to support your clinical decisions.
SESSION_NOTES_READONLY_HINT: Viewing a past session — editing is disabled.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_SUBTITLE: Manage patients linked to your care relationships.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_SUBTITLE_ADD: Fill in the details to link the patient to your care.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_SUBTITLE_EDI: Update name, contact, or reset the patient's login password.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_ACCOUNT_HELP: Email and password the patient uses to sign in to the app.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_PHONE_HELP: Enter mobile number with area code (10 or 11 digits).
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ERROR_PHONE_REQUIR: Enter a valid mobile number with area code.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_GENERATED_PA: Auto-generated 5-digit password. Copy and share with the patient before saving.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_RESET_PASSWO: Leave blank to keep the current password. Minimum 5 characters.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ERROR_RESET_PASSWO: New password must be at least 5 characters.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove this patient from your list?
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_API_UNAVAILABLE: Sign in with Supabase (disable auth bypass) to manage patients via the API.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_DEMO_HINT: Demo list (5 patients). Click a row to open the clinical dashboard.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ROW_HINT: Click a patient row to open the dashboard. Use the buttons on the right for session, edit, or delete.
